title: Phase D review — the four built changes

steps.headline: The welcome screen now has the app's frame: Settings gear and Projects folder on the left, window buttons on the right.
steps.changed: The same header the Terminal view has, minus everything session-specific: no session switcher, no chat/terminal toggle, no status bar, no chat box. The welcome content below is untouched.
steps.measured: 2 buttons on the screen before; 5 now (gear, Projects, minimize, maximize, close)
steps.notice: You can open Settings or Projects before starting a session, and drag the window by its top edge here like anywhere else. On a Mac the traffic lights sit in their usual pill; on a phone it is gear + Projects only.
steps.risk: The mascot and buttons sit a little lower to make room for the bar. Worth a look on a wallpaper theme — the bar takes the theme's glass like the session header does.

steps.headline: The find bar has its own row above the messages; nothing is covered while you search.
steps.changed: Browser-style: a full-width strip under the header with the field and arrows at its right edge. The messages shift down by the strip's height while it is open and back when it closes.
steps.measured: 0 px of the first message covered, vs a 292 × 41 px bar over it before
steps.notice: Press Ctrl+F and the chat nudges down; press Esc and it returns. If you were at the bottom of the chat you stay at the bottom.
steps.risk: That nudge is a visible jump each time. Under a floating-chrome theme the strip sits 6 px lower to clear the header — check it looks right there.

steps.headline: The category pills are the Marketplace's pills now — 14 px text, same shape — and Favorites only sits at the end of the row.
steps.changed: One shared pill used by both the Marketplace filters and this row (the Marketplace is pixel-identical). Favorites only lights up like the others when on; its ★ stays.
steps.measured: 14 px text vs 12 px; the row is 8 px taller
steps.notice: Easier to read and to hit; the same control you already know from the Marketplace. Cards below start slightly lower. At phone width the six pills wrap to two lines.
steps.risk: Favorites only used to light up in a paler tint; now it is a solid accent like a category — say if you want the paler look back.

steps.path: Composer → Browse skills → scrolled to the end
steps.headline: “Add Skills” is the last card of the grid, filling the empty slot instead of starting a row of its own.
steps.changed: Moved into the same grid as the installed skills. Search results already ended with it; unchanged there.
steps.notice: The drawer ends flush. When a category or Favorites-only matches nothing you get a short message (with a Browse the Marketplace button where that helps) instead of a lone dashed card.
steps.risk: When nothing at all is installed you now see the app's standard “No skills installed yet” message — next step shows it.

steps.headline: A brand-new install's drawer says “No skills installed yet” with a Browse the Marketplace button.
steps.changed: The app's standard empty message, centred, instead of one dashed card at the far left of an empty row.
steps.notice: A new user is told what to do next in one line.
